PCI SAQ Readiness Kit for Small Merchants
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- pci_saq_readiness_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- pci_saq_readiness_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (5 sheets)
- pci_incident_response_one_pager.docx : editable template
- pci_service_provider_list.docx : editable template
- pci_acquirer_confirmation_letter_draft.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
